product.title: Island in the Sky of Canyonlands Helicopter Tour

description.text: Soar above Canyonlands National Park on a 45-minute scenic helicopter flight from Moab. Capture aerial views of Dead Horse Point, Thelma and Louise Point, the Colorado River, Behind the Rocks, and Island in the Sky rim country with pilot narration. Stops include Dead Horse Point, Thelma and Louise Point, Colorado River, Island in the Sky, Grand View Point. Window seats and headsets keep the short flight focused on canyon overlooks and red-rock photo angles. Ideal for visitors basing in Moab who want a guided Canyonlands National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or backcountry routes on their own.
